signal: Onspring launched Onspring AI, a suite of GRC capabilities powered by Anthropic's Claude, offered as a configurable add-on module.

email.body1:
Ashleigh, saw Onspring ship Onspring AI, your new GRC capability suite built on Claude.

A new add-on usually opens more in-market enterprise accounts in the Northeast than a team can personally reach before the quarter closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ashleigh, quick follow-up for Onspring.

Right after a product launch, expectations on pipeline tend to outrun what a regional team can cover. Most directors don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your Northeast territory needs, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ashleigh, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's reply rate likely compares to peer GRC software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ashleigh, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Post-launch is busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise GRC motion? I'll tailor it to Onspring either way.
